evidence_quotes.quote: A cross-comparative analysis of child poverty across sub-Saharan Africa: the case of Francophone and Anglophone African states
Cynthia Lum Fonta School for Policy, University of Bristol, Bristol, UK, and David Gordon and Zoi Toumpakari School for Policy Studies, University of Bristol, Bristol, UK
This study utilised data from the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) conducted between 2000 and 2019 involving 22 sub-Saharan African states.

rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: full text not accessible for target record). Record R0131B1D0A1D8 specifies Bell, Morag & Franceys, Richard (1995), 'Improving Human Welfare through Appropriate Technology: Government Responsibility, Citizen Duty or Customer Choice', whereas the retrieved PDF is an entirely different 2025 article by Cynthia Lum Fonta, David Gordon, and Zoi Toumpakari titled 'A cross-comparative analysis of child poverty across sub-Saharan Africa: the case of Francophone and Anglophone African states' (International Journal of Health Governance, Vol. 30 No. 1, 2025, pp. 44-59, DOI 10.1108/IJHG-05-2024-0057). Per screening rules, eligibility of the target 1995 record cannot be guessed from metadata/title alone or evaluated from the wrong PDF, requiring decision = 'cannot_tell' and exclusion_code = 'NONE'.
